report.markdown:
# Sydney Opera House Architect and Opening Year

## Architect and Opening

The Sydney Opera House was designed by the Danish architect Jørn Utzon in 1957. [1][2] The building officially opened on October 20, 1973. [2][3][4]

## Sources

1. [https://www.britannica.com/topic/Sydney-Opera-House](https://www.britannica.com/topic/Sydney-Opera-House) — britannica.com, fetched 2026-10-31

4. [Opening of the Sydney Opera House](https://mhnsw.au/opening-of-the-sydney-opera-house) — mhnsw.au, fetched 2026-10-31
